key_patterns: All five required sections are present: Who I Am, My Role in the 9-Layer Architecture, What I Do Each Sprint Cycle, Hard Constraints, Communication Style
Layer 9 CFO responsibilities correctly enumerated: per-task_type spend tracking, weekly cost-per-agent reports, 80%/95% burn alerts
Sprint cycle steps accurately reflect spec: reads logs/routing/*.jsonl, computes burn % against €200, emits budget.warning and budget.freeze, writes to workspace/outputs/cfo/YYYY-WW.md
Escalation path correctly specified: Harvey first, Tarek if >€160/week
Communication style section matches spec: bullet lists, numbers, no adjectives
